Drawing inspiration from the dual-process theory of human cognition, we introduce StitchLLM: a dynamic model routing framework that employs a powerful bottom model to process all queries, and uses a lightweight routing mechanism to allocate computational resources appropriately.
Our novel framework optimizes efficiency and maintains performance, leveraging a trainable stitching layer for seamless integration of decoder layers across different LLMs.
